revision_note: Run from the lane root. All inputs are committed blobs at supplied full revision; no checker or census rerun is needed for these aggregations.
registry_script:
import collections,json,re,subprocess,sys
for rev in sys.argv[1:]:
 t=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",rev+":corpus/SOURCES.md"],text=True)
 rows=[[c.strip() for c in x.split("|")[1:-1]] for x in t.splitlines() if re.match(r"^\|\s*S\d{3,}\s*\|",x)]
 print(json.dumps({"revision":rev,"rows":len(rows),"tiers":dict(collections.Counter(r[3] for r in rows)),"statuses":dict(collections.Counter(r[7] for r in rows)),"malformed":sum(len(r)!=11 for r in rows)},sort_keys=True))
mention_script:
import json,re,subprocess
d=json.load(open(".ufo/waves/round-14/repair/integration-verification.json")); n=0
for p in d["mention_sweep"]["scope"]:
 t=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",d["implementation"]+":"+p],text=True)
 n+=sum(bool(re.search(d["mention_sweep"]["pattern"],line,re.I)) for line in t.splitlines())
print(n)
history_script:
import difflib,json,subprocess
d=json.load(open(".ufo/waves/round-14/repair/integration-verification.json"))
def blob(rev,p): return subprocess.check_output(["git","show",rev+":"+p],text=True)
print({p:sum(x.startswith("- ") for x in difflib.ndiff(blob(d["baseline"],p).splitlines(),blob(d["implementation"],p).splitlines())) for p in d["historical_removed_or_replaced_lines"]})
